_help: The Leonida map. One entry per place. Edit here, then run: node tools/build-map.mjs (writes dist/data/map.js; --check validates only). pos is [longitude, latitude] on the Florida-shaped stand-in outline, placed from the area a source names: precision 'area' = named town/district, position estimated; 'region' = only the region is known. pos null = no source says where yet (listed under Not placed yet). status follows the site's labels: Official, Tested, Reported, Patched, Unverified. A place may only be Tested with checked.on, checked.version and checked.platform. cat: weapon, vehicle, secret, money, mission, landmark, service.

regions.name: Vice City
regions.blurb: Neon, money and the biggest city in Leonida. Vice-Dale County.

regions.name: Leonida Keys
regions.blurb: Island chain and long bridges. Mariana County: Key Lento, where the story starts, and Mile Zero Air Station.

regions.name: Grassrivers
regions.blurb: Swamp, airboats and things with teeth.

regions.name: Port Gellhorn
regions.blurb: Faded Gulf town in Kelly County, next to Wild Hog Point.

regions.name: Ambrosia
regions.blurb: Sugar country by Lake Leonida. Raceway and refinery.

regions.name: Mount Kalaga
regions.blurb: Forest and rivers in Lummox County: Mount Kalaga National Park and the Kalaga Reservoir.

places.name: Mile Zero Air Station
places.summary: Military base with a row of Rhino tanks and parked combat jets. The fastest way to get a tank or a jet.
how: Drive west from Key Lento through Abismo Key and Southwind.
Easiest way in: the Mile Zero Air Station Southeast stunt jump on the southern access road.
Tanks are left of the large building by the runway; jets are to the right, by the hangars.
places.needs: Expect a 5-star Wanted Level, 6 if you start blowing things up.

places.name: Vice City International (VCIA)
places.summary: The airport. Two runways with commercial jets always parked, plus service vehicles and a terminal full of ATMs.
how: Sneak onto either main runway and take a parked jet.
Break into the ATMs in the central terminal.
places.reward: Commercial jets, Brute Ripley service vehicle, ATM cash

places.name: Assassin Nipper .38 cache
places.summary: A suppressed unique revolver in a hidden cache at the south tip of the eastern island of the Permit Keys. No fight needed.
how: Take a boat to the Permit Keys.
At the south tip of the eastern island, use Focus Mode (L3+R3) to find the cache.

places.name: La Cascara Motel
places.summary: Kolt gang hideout with a safe and the Scrapper VF5C, a unique rifle, on the top floor.
how: Come up the south stairwell (less guarded) and stick to the outer walkways.
The Scrapper VF5C is on the top floor, by the safe.
places.needs: Safe code reported as 6969 by GamesRadar+; some safe codes are randomised per player.

places.name: Kitty Litter labs (gold SMG)
places.summary: Destroy every Kitty Litter lab for Tyrone and you get a unique gold SMG, and Tyrone buys your narcotics at the top price. The first lab is in the La Perle trailer park.
how: First lab: trailer park opposite Zenon's Pawn Shop / Ammu-Nation in La Perle.
Other labs: Decor District, behind Peterson's Autoshop in Rockridge, by Fleeca Field stadium, south of Vice City Hospital, behind Cross My Heart Tattoos, south-east of the Jack of Hearts.
Shoot the smoking pink flask, then run.
places.needs: Unlocked after missions for Tyrone (Dealer's Choice).

places.name: Crosstown Police Station
places.summary: Cop car trunks hold assault rifles, shotguns and body armour. Randy's Pegassi Infernus is parked on the top floor of the station car park.
how: Police pickups: climb on the bed and open the crate. No alarm.
Cruisers: slim jim the door first, then the trunk opens without an alarm.
Infernus: Clone Key, drive to the top floor, leave over the stunt jump.
places.reward: Free guns and armour, Pegassi Infernus for Randy
places.needs: Slim jim from Moses (Chapter 2); Clone Key for the Infernus.

places.name: Chuck's Tackle & Shot
places.summary: The earliest place to buy a mask (Neckwear aisle), just down the road from Jason's house. Kirk's flyer is by the Ammu-Nation near Jason's place.
how: Walk forward, turn left down the aisle; Neckwear is on the right.
Set Wear Style to 1 in the items menu to cover the face.
places.reward: Mask (harder for cops to identify you)

places.name: Badger R&D Tower
places.summary: Start of the Vice City easter egg: climb to the top and a GTA: Vice City sound plays. Substations across the map lead to a portal into old-school Vice City. The Thelma dancer card is at the top.
how: Climb the tower: inside stairs, then ladders.
Visit the substations: Downtown, Balsero, Key Lento, Penmarch Isle (Washington Beach), Crosstown, Port Gellhorn, Gloriana Key, south Port Gellhorn, North Mariana County.
Pull the lever by the portal.
places.reward: Tommy Vercetti shirt and motorcycle, for both Jason and Lucia

places.name: Jason's House
places.summary: Five reading collectibles and a basketball hoop. Missable: collect them before the end of Chapter 1. Jason's boat is at the dock.
how: Peach Palm Dr. Books and magazines are on the kitchen table, the round table, the balcony, the bedroom cabinet and in the workshop below.

places.name: Skunk Ape sighting
places.summary: GTA's Bigfoot. The first sighting is across Gambit Bay from Jason's house, at the dead-end road on the peninsula.
how: Take Jason's boat across Gambit Bay.
Follow it with Focus Mode (L3+R3) into the mangroves, then call Kirk from the flyer.
places.reward: Starts the Skunk Ape side story with Kirk

places.name: Christmas House
places.summary: A house lit up with Christmas decorations at night, where Sunset Dr meets Laguna Dr. A WAiNK Curiosity, and the Nagasaki Rudolph Tao parked outside is a Standout Vehicle.
how: Scan the house and the car with WAiNK.
A stunt jump is south-east of the house, near Laguna Ln.

places.name: Exotic Animals Front
places.summary: A robbery with a bonus: talk to the chatty parrot in the cage to find an extra hidden money stash.
how: During the robbery, talk to the parrot.

places.name: Kenton's shipwrecks
places.summary: Sunken Spanish wrecks with sets of treasure to dig up with a metal detector and sell to Kenton. Nuestra Señora de la Noche alone has 7.
how: Get scuba gear at Island Dreams, or use Kenton's Huntress boat.
Wrecks: south of Key Lento (de la Noche, de la Ética Laxa), off the south-east coast (Urca de Cinco Torres, Lujuriosa), east of Key Lento (Urca de Santa Sierra).
places.reward: Treasure sets, big payouts for complete sets

places.name: BURG Facility #1 (underwater)
places.summary: One of five sunken BURG facilities, marked by a yellow platform sticking out of the water. Each counts as an Underwater Discovery.
how: #1 west of Mile Zero Air Station, #4 north of it, #5 east of Key Lento, #2 east of Little Hardin Island, #3 west of Wild Hog Point.

places.name: Watson Bay garages
places.summary: Wyman's classic cars: collect from the Paradise garage here, and a Reynolds Kit Car scrap sits behind Donnie's Auto Repair, next to the Pay 'n' Spray.
how: Follow the alley behind Donnie's Auto Repair; the Kit Car is in front of the shutters.
places.reward: Reynolds Kit Car part for Wyman

places.name: Old Fort Rd gas station
places.summary: An abandoned gas station north of Grassrivers Cafe & Deli hides a '70 Riata for Wyman.
how: Old Fort Rd, Shoreless Keys.

places.name: Paul Walker's car
places.summary: A Fast & Furious nod: the Penumbra locked in a garage on Vespucci Island. It respawns if you wreck it.
how: Break into the garage; the alarm switch is on the wall to your left.
Open the door, hotwire the car, drive.

places.name: Honeycomb Emerus
places.summary: One of the fastest cars, in a parking lot outside a dealership and car rental across from the hospital. Advanced security and trackers.
how: Needs a Key Cloner; expect the tracker to call the cops.

places.name: Dockyard container car
places.summary: A fast Emerus locked inside a shipping container at the dockyard. Trespassing gets you wanted.
how: Open the container with the cut-off tool.

places.name: North-west Capri garage
places.summary: The Seaspray Emerus sits in a garage you can open with the Snap Gun. Capri driveways also spawn the Pegassi Toros and the Buckingham Windsor Drop.
how: Snap Gun the garage; the car has every security feature, so plan the getaway.

places.name: Boone Speedway
places.summary: A Thrax Truffade on a trailer at the raceway entrance, and Randy's Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire at the back of the M7 junkyard just east.
how: Junkyard: off Galerina St; open the gates first, it is M7 gang turf.
The Thrax is heavily secured; it is easier late in the game.
places.reward: Thrax Truffade, Gauntlet Hellfire for Randy

places.name: Peacock Estates mansion
places.summary: Randy's Piccia Furia is at a mansion on Palladia Ln.
how: Clone Key the car, open the garage shutters, leave through the gates.

places.name: Leaf Links mansion
places.summary: Randy's Mamba GT is behind the building on the right. The key is in a bowl on the table behind the sofa. It has a tracker.
how: Get the key inside first, then drive straight to Randy and outpace the police.

places.name: Status Auto Imports
places.summary: The most common spawn for the Buckingham Windsor Drop. Leave through the windows on your left. The Y Hotel in Washington Beach often has one outside too.
how: Clone Key, then out through the windows to the left.

places.name: The Vault Night Club
places.summary: An Ocelot Jugular is sometimes parked outside; another is almost always in a garage on Atlantic Ave in Vice Beach.
how: If the garage is empty, leave and come back later.

places.name: Willie's Service Center
places.summary: The first Reynolds Kit Car scrap for Wyman: a blue and yellow building on SW 7th Ave, just north of the 7th Avenue Garage. Another scrap is on Casanova Island in the Rialto Islands.
how: SW 7th Ave, Salton.

places.name: Ocelot Bloodless Jugular
places.summary: In a garage at the southern house of a four-home cluster on Belville's northern edge. Randy pays $10,615, plus $5,000 if it's pristine. The owner is armed.
how: Key Cloner to get in; the tracker is standard and won't call the cops.

places.name: Waning Sands villa
places.summary: Randy's Pegassi Vitello is at the posh villa on Flamingo Pkwy, east of Belville.
how: Clone Key the car, then set off your charges for a quick escape.

places.name: The Gellhorn bunker
places.summary: A foliage-covered bunker across from Burnout Scooters, near Moses' garage. It starts the missing tourists hunt and the serial-killer story.
how: See the missing-person posters, then call the Kelly County Tip Line.
Bodies: junkyard behind the Pay 'N' Spray; trailer park under the water tower (north); the U-shaped lake on the Wild Hog Point border.
Wait for the Tip Line to call back, then return to the bunker. Push Square suggests going alone.

places.name: Moses' garage
places.summary: Sell stolen cars for $1,000 to $20,000 depending on the car. Moses gives you the slim jim and often says where the cars he wants are. He pays around $3,400 for the BF Bandito.
how: After one sale he won't buy again for a while.

places.name: Bud and the UFO
places.summary: At night Bud stands on his car shouting at the sky near the beach in south Kelly County. After you talk, drive the dirt roads in the central Gellhorn woods until the radio cuts out.
how: Meet Bud after dark (around 8:30pm worked for Push Square), alone.
Find the abandoned car pointing into the woods and follow the trail of clothes.
places.reward: The Truth Is Out There trophy

places.name: Wild Hog Point coast
places.summary: A Reynolds Kit Car scrap in a Scoop shipping container on the coast far west of Port Gellhorn.
how: Look for the Scoop container on the shore.

places.name: Mamba GT by the state prison
places.summary: A '64 Mamba GT in a garage on the east side of Gellhorn, north of the Leonida State Prison.
how: Check the garages north of the prison.

places.name: Paradise Wines Vineyard Bar
places.summary: A Pegassi Toros is often parked outside.
how: Check the car park.

places.name: Ambrosia Raceway
places.summary: Demolition derby on the oval: good money even for bad drivers. PC Gamer reports over three grand a win.
how: Enter the demolition race and be the last car running.

places.name: Xero Gas alley Mamba GT
places.summary: A '64 Mamba GT down the alley next to the Xero Gas Station, between US-35 and Lakewood Way.
how: Follow the alley south from the Xero Gas Station.

places.name: Trailer south of Grassrivers
places.summary: A trailer safe whose code is hidden in the postcards on the trailer wall. GamesRadar+ lists it as 44017.
how: Use Focus Mode on the postcards to read the numbers.
places.needs: Some safe codes are randomised per player; read the postcards in your own game.

places.name: BF Bandito swamp loop
places.summary: The white off-road racer circles a marked search area in the swamp. Block the track with your car and he stops. Moses pays about $3,400.
how: Park across the track and stand by it; press L2 to focus when he calls out.
His friends chase you out of the swamp; the Bandito outruns them.

places.name: Kalaga Reservoir mine
places.area: Mount Kalaga National Park, Lummox County
places.summary: The abandoned mine where the Port Gellhorn serial-killer story ends.
how: Finish the Gellhorn bunker story first; the meeting point is sent to your partner's phone.
places.needs: After the missing tourists in Port Gellhorn.

places.name: Lake Tallaloko houses
places.summary: Properties here can spawn a Buckingham Windsor Drop.
how: Check the driveways.

places.name: Bret's hunting jobs
places.summary: Jason's old military buddy pays more and more for the animals he asks for.
how: Jason only.

places.name: Jet Ski Dog
places.summary: A dog on a jet ski that rescues you at sea. Swim away from your boat, far from the coast and other boats, and listen for Cool Dog.
how: GamesRadar+ found it in Leonida Bay; players report other spots too.

places.name: McKittrick Farm
places.summary: Crop-dusting job for Kyle: dust three fields, then land on the strip. An abandoned dino mini golf nearby hides a Vice City Flamingos card, according to a reader.
how: Fly over the pink areas on the mini map, then land and talk to Kyle.

places.name: Brooks Boatworks safe
places.summary: Safe code reported as 6823, written on the wall map in the smallest building of the compound. Kingpin Bowling Alley (0330) and Nova Auto Junkyard (7777) are also listed.
how: Look for the code with Focus Mode, or threaten staff for it.
places.needs: Some codes are randomised per player.

places.name: Royal Ruby Emerus
places.area: Vespucci Mansion, Vespucci Island, Rialto Islands
places.summary: A blood-red custom Progen Emerus parked at a drug lord's mansion. Game Rant says it has no lock and no tracker, making it one of the best free supercars early on. Where: Outside the guarded Vespucci Mansion on Vespucci Island, the middle Rialto island between Vice City and Vice Beach.
how: Drive to Vespucci Island and drop a pin on the Vespucci Mansion.
Hop the front fence; guards patrol the roof and halls.
Optionally loot the two safes and the Kingpin Heathen rifle inside first.
Open the gate, get in the Emerus and drive off.
Sources disagree: Guides describe the exact parking spot differently (by the gate vs in a garage on the south side).
places.reward: Progen Emerus (no lock, no tracker); Game Rant: about $30k to sell in top condition, similar to register.
places.needs: Armed guards on site. Registration needs Moses (Chapter 2) or a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Purple Drank Emerus
places.area: Chatfield Storage & Logistics robbery, Waxman Island
places.summary: A pearlescent purple Emerus stashed by car thieves. Game Rant says it sits in a shipping container, needs no key and has no tracker; it has nitrous but no storage slots. Where: At the Waxman Island robbery opportunity (Chatfield Storage & Logistics), east of downtown Vice City.
how: Go to the robbery site on Waxman Island.
Deal with the gang members; Game Rant gives the shack safe code as 5800.
Press the gate button so you have a clear exit.
Take the Emerus out of its container and drive away.
Sources disagree: Game Rant puts the site on the east of Waxman Island; other guides say the west side.
places.reward: Nitrous-equipped Progen Emerus; about $29,000 to register.

places.name: Black Widow Emerus
places.summary: A Progen Emerus locked in a yellow SCOOP container at the docks. GamesRadar says it is unlocked and deactivated once you are inside. Where: Inside the one openable SCOOP shipping container at the Vice City County Dockyard.
how: Unlock the Cut-Off Tool in the Chapter 3 mission Meet the Heders.
Go to the Vice City County Dockyard (you are trespassing).
Use Focus mode to find the one container you can open; evade or knock out security.
Cut the lock and drive out fast before police close in.
places.needs: Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3); restricted area with security.

places.name: Seaspray Emerus
places.summary: A race-spec Progen Emerus with its own livery. Dexerto lists speed 8.9, among the fastest standouts. Where: Inside a garage in northwest Capri.
how: Unlock the Snap Gun.
Open the garage in northwest Capri with it.
Expect advanced security and trackers on the way out.
places.needs: Snap Gun; advanced security and trackers.

places.name: Andrew Node's Thrax
places.summary: A modified Truffade Thrax that GamesRadar ranks as the fastest car in the game. No keys or trackers, but $70,000 to register. Where: Behind a pair of garage doors on the west side of a building on Starfish Island.
how: Legit route: scan 10 of the 15 No Flusher tags around Vice Beach with WAiNK It and follow the group-chat clues.
Glitch route (may be patched): wedge a car diagonally against the garage doors, crouch in the gap and open your phone to clip inside.
Open the doors from the inside panel and drive off before security reacts.
places.needs: Private property with security; the glitch may be patched.

places.name: Truffade Thrax (Randy finale)
places.area: Dalton Island Club, southeast corner of Leonida
places.summary: The last car on Randy's Wish List, unlocked as the optional mission 'Steal the Truffade Thrax' once every other list car is delivered. Where: Parked directly opposite Spa Spendido at the Dalton Island Club, reached by ferry or from Gloriana Key.
how: Deliver all other Randy's Wish List cars.
Start 'Steal the Truffade Thrax' from Touch Pad > Story > Optional.
At Dalton Island Club, quietly deal with the two guards.
Clone the key, drive onto the ferry, lose the 3-star wanted level on arrival and park in Randy's garage.
places.reward: Completes Randy's list, leading to Delivery Day and Raul's Tempesta.
places.needs: Key Cloner; two guards; 3-star wanted level when you land.

places.name: Raul's Pegassi Tempesta (reward)
places.summary: The final reward for Randy's Wish List. It is registered to you automatically and comes with the Domestic Timbers garage. Where: Inside the Balsero garage that Randy texts you after the Wish List is complete.
how: Finish every Randy's Wish List car, including the Thrax.
Complete Delivery Day ($25,000 and the Supply & Demand trophy).
After Randy calls and texts, drive to the Balsero garage and collect the car.
places.reward: Pegassi Tempesta, auto-registered, plus the Domestic Timbers garage.
places.needs: Whole Randy's Wish List (Key Cloner, Chapter 3+).

places.name: Gold Rush Tempesta
places.area: Cirque de Cuisine, Ocean Beach, Vice Beach
places.summary: A gold Pegassi Tempesta from the Blinged Up standout set, protected by advanced security. Where: Outside the Cirque de Cuisine restaurant in Ocean Beach.
how: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3).
Check outside Cirque de Cuisine in Ocean Beach.
Clone the key and deal with the tracker before registering.
Sources disagree: Some guides place it in the car park at Crimson Palms Condominiums, Washington Beach, instead.

places.name: Mojito Tempesta
places.summary: A Pegassi Tempesta with its own street-racer livery (Dexerto speed 8.2). Where: Outside a hotel in Tequesta Retreat.
how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Pegassi '96 Infernus (Randy)
places.area: Crosstown Police Station lockup, Crosstown, Vice City
places.summary: The only sports car in the police car park: a purple Infernus wanted by Randy. It carries a tracker. Where: On level 7 of the multi-storey police lockup next to the Crosstown Police Station.
how: Wait until Randy texts its location; PC Gamer says a yellow window-cleaning lift then appears on the south side.
Ride the lift in, or slip in behind a police car at the gate.
Go up to level 7, clone the key, and drive out fast so the tracker does not ping police.
Sources disagree: Push Square and GTA-Xtreme give NW 9th St; PC Gamer calls the lockup the building west of the station in southwest Crosstown. Some guides write NE 9th St.
places.reward: Pegassi Infernus for Randy, or keep it.

places.name: Gold Rope Infernus
places.summary: A '96 Pegassi Infernus with a gold custom makeover from the Blinged Up set (Dexerto speed 8.3). Where: Parked outside a house in Ambrosia.
how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Pegassi Vitello (Randy)
places.area: Flamingo Pkwy, Waning Sands, Leonard County
places.summary: A Randy's Wish List supercar kept at a gated villa. Where: In the garage nearest the house, on the right as you face the entrance, at a posh villa on Flamingo Pkwy east of Belville.
how: Hop the villa fence.
Push Square suggests planting explosives on the gate without setting them off.
Clone the key in the right-hand garage, then blow the gate and escape.

places.name: Dante's Vitello
places.summary: A one-off Pegassi Vitello with a custom finish (Dexerto speed 8.6). Where: At Dante Fresh's mansion on Starfish Island.
how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Dolce Vita Itali RSX
places.summary: A custom-modded Grotti Itali RSX with an Italian-themed design (Dexerto speed 8.6). Where: At a luxury villa on the Rialto Islands.
how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Tsunami Zorrusso
places.summary: A one-of-a-kind Granforma Zorrusso tuned to racing spec (Dexerto speed 8.3). Where: At a luxury residence in Peacock Estates.
how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Piccia Furia (Randy)
places.area: Palladia Ln, Peacock Estates, Peacock Bay
places.summary: A Randy's Wish List sports car in a waterside mansion garage. Where: In the garage of a mansion on Palladia Ln, reached by going left of the front gate and over the hedge.
how: Skip the front gate; go left and hop the hedge.
Follow the path between the water and the garage and enter by its side door.
Clone the key, open the shutter and leave through the gates.

places.name: Big Cat Furia
places.summary: A leopard-print Piccia Furia from the Leonida Man set (Dexerto speed 7.8). Where: At a luxury residence on Starfish Island.
how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Pegassi Toros (stock)
places.area: Pegassi Residences, Bayside Dr, Tequesta Retreat
places.summary: The game's Urus-style SUV and a Randy's Wish List car. GTA-Xtreme saw one here around 6:30 pm in-game, but the space can be empty. Where: Outside the entrance to Pegassi Residences on Bayside Dr.
how: Visit Bayside Dr in early evening.
Watch for security at the entrance.
Clone the key if it is locked and keep moving if it has an advanced tracker.
places.needs: Key Cloner; security at the entrance; spawn not guaranteed.

places.name: Lustrous Toros (gold)
places.summary: The viral gold 'Lamborghini Urus' is the Pegassi Lustrous Toros. It has an alarm and an advanced tracker. Where: Inside the closed garage beside a pale mansion on the south side of the road through the middle of Casanova Island.
how: Drive to Casanova Island, east of Vespucci Island.
Lift the garage door next to the mansion by hand.
Scan the car and use the Key Cloner.
Take the cash and collectible card from the workbench, then lose the police.
Sources disagree: One outlet calls the Casanova gold SUV a Charred Toros; the Charred Toros is a different car in La Perle.
places.reward: Gold Pegassi Toros, plus cash and a collectible card in the garage.
places.needs: Key Cloner (Chapter 3); alarm and advanced tracker.

places.name: Charred Toros
places.area: La Perle trap house, NW 10th Ave
places.summary: A donk-converted Toros kept by San4San. GTA-Xtreme found it unlocked with no tracker, making it an easy early rare car. Where: In the front yard of a fenced single-storey trap house on NW 10th Ave, south of the highway interchange in La Perle.
how: Approach from the neighbouring lot to the side or rear fence.
Scan it with WAiNK.
If it is unlocked, get in and drive off past the armed guards.
places.reward: Donk Pegassi Toros; GTA-Xtreme estimates about $9,000 to register.

places.name: DriveShaft Gauntlet (Dom's Charger)
places.summary: A rusty blue Bravado Gauntlet with a hood blower, styled after Dom Toretto's Charger. Where: Behind Sid Thompson's wooden house, northeast of the Grayson town marker near the railway by San Malo Bay.
how: Drive to Grayson in northern Leonida.
Go behind Sid Thompson's house.
Get in and drive off.
Sources disagree: Some guides say it is in a shed, others that it is parked behind the house.

places.name: Vanessa's Growler (pink)
places.area: La Perle, next to Auntie's Place
places.summary: A baby-pink Pfister Growler (Porsche Cayman look) left as a gift for Vanessa. GamesRadar says it is free to take and keep. Where: In a lock-up next to Auntie's Place in La Perle.
how: In Chapter 3, move into Vanessa's apartment and work out her laptop password.
Read the message pointing to La Perle.
Open the lock-up next to Auntie's Place with code 92665.

places.name: Ocelot Bloodless Jugular (Randy)
places.summary: A white sedan on Randy's list that he cannot locate for you. Where: In the garage of the southernmost of four homes laid out in an X on the northern edge of Belville.
how: Drive to northern Belville.
Find the four-home cluster and break into the southern house's garage.
places.reward: PC Gamer: Randy pays $10,615, plus $5,000 if pristine.

places.name: Bloodbath Phoenix
places.summary: A supercharged '77 Imponte Phoenix with a custom design. Where: At an illegal chop shop in Salton.
how: Find the chop shop in Salton.
Scan the Phoenix with WAiNK and steal it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Firebug Dominator
places.area: La Cascara Motel, Port Gellhorn, Kelly County
places.summary: A supercharged custom Vapid Dominator and one of the motel's key valuables. Where: Parked outside La Cascara Motel, the Kolt & Associates hideout at the northwest end of Port Gellhorn.
how: Unlock the motel robbery by finishing June Warehouse or Brooks Boatworks.
Deal with the Kolt guards.
Break the window, hotwire and drive off.

places.name: Devil's Rope Gauntlet
places.summary: A modded Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire with a custom livery (Dexerto speed 8.3). Where: In an Ambrosia garage held by The Final Chapter biker gang.
how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Biker gang site. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Revenant Gauntlet
